title: Vault 634 Evac
description: A woman in a green and yellow Vault-Tec jumpsuit runs hand-in-hand with a woman in a flowing red dress through the destroyed interior of a ruined vault. They are fleeing beneath a shattered dome ceiling revealing a toxic pink and yellow sky, surrounded by falling debris, scattered film reels, playing cards, and damaged classical paintings.
prompt: A dramatic scene inside a destroyed Vault-Tec shelter with a shattered glass dome ceiling revealing a poisonous pink and yellow sky. A woman in a green Vault 634 jumpsuit with radiation symbols runs hand-in-hand with a woman in a flowing red gown, both looking back in fear as debris falls around them. Scattered across the cracked floor are film reels, playing cards, broken paintings of horses, and a fallen sign reading 'FOLLOW BLINDLY' and 'VAULT-634 EVAC'. Cinematic lighting, detailed textures, painted style.
